title: Microsoft deepens OpenAI investment in multiyear deal

sources.quote: This agreement follows our previous investments in 2019 and 2021.
We have an investment in OpenAI Global, LLC (“OpenAI”) and have made total funding commitments of $13 billion, of which $11.6 billion has been funded as of September 30, 2025.

explain: In January 2023 Microsoft announced a new multiyear, multibillion-dollar investment in OpenAI (widely reported at about $10 billion, but Microsoft did not give a number). Counting 2019, 2021 and 2023, Microsoft says it committed $13 billion in total, of which $11.6 billion had been paid by September 2025.
